title: SAUNAS. II. Discovery of Cross-shaped X-Ray Emission and a Rotating Circumnuclear Disk in the Supermassive S0 Galaxy NGC 5084
question: What is the multi-wavelength structure of the S0 galaxy NGC 5084 (X-ray halo, circumnuclear disk, radio lobes) and what formation scenario explains it?

evidence.quote: At a distance of $D=  29.91\pm2.12$ Mpc (cite: koribalski+2004aj128_16)
we use the definition in (cite: smith+2021mnras500_1933) to measure the mass of the central SMBH based on their fitted relation with the line width at the half-maximum W$_{50}$

recipe.goal: Fit disk geometry from HST dust lane
recipe.method: Reference points along the F702W dust arc defined in SAODS9 and fit with an ellipse, with 1000 bootstrap/Monte Carlo realisations displacing points within the PSF FWHM

recipe.goal: Detect CO(2-1) and make moment maps
recipe.method: Spectral rebinning to 12.9 km/s, per-pixel Gaussian fits for intensity, centroid and dispersion; pixels below 95% confidence masked

recipe.goal: Measure rotation velocity from summed spectrum
recipe.method: Sum spectra of significant pixels, measure half-maximum velocities by interpolation, 1000 Monte Carlo realisations displacing points by noise
Apply Smith et al. 2021 W50-inclination relation, propagating uncertainties of relation, inclination and spectra with Monte Carlo

evidence.quote: A total mass of $\log_{10}\left( \frac{M_{\rm BH}}{M_{\odot}} \right) = 7.66^{+0.21}_{-0.15}$ is determined for the SMBH of NGC 5084.
with a median inclination of $i=71.2^{+1.8}_{-1.7}$ degrees

not_stated_but_needed: ALMA CASA/pipeline version and whether the archive or ARI-L cube was used for the quoted numbers
Beam, rms, image size and cell size of the cube
Exact region and mask used when summing spectra, and what the 95% confidence masking threshold is relative to
Distance of the HST ellipse reference points (SAODS9 selection) not reproducible exactly
Inclination assumed in the M_BH formula (HST-derived) and how W50 was corrected for instrumental broadening
missing_for_reproduction: Moment-map masking details and summed-region definition
score_reason: ALMA part is simple and archival with explicit method, but key settings are unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Public archival data, short recipe, numeric results (V_rot, W50, M_BH).
